boards.title: Your First Weekend at Roger Williams University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: An under-21-safe first-weekend sequence of campus landmarks, waterfront scenery, arts, and a nearby public park.

cards.entity_name: Richard L. Bready Mount Hope Bay Sailing & Education Center
cards.title: Begin beside Mount Hope Bay
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · waterfront campus
cards.notes: Start at the Sailing & Education Center to orient yourself by the water, then identify the walk back toward the academic buildings and residence halls.
cards.short_summary: A waterfront landmark for getting your bearings.
cards.evidence_claim: Roger Williams University’s campus map lists the Richard L. Bready Mount Hope Bay Sailing & Education Center.
cards.access_notes: Use exterior and public areas only; follow posted facility-access rules.

cards.title: Locate a recreation option
cards.subtitle: Friday late afternoon · campus
cards.notes: Find the Campus Recreation Center and check the desk or university information for current entry procedures before planning a future workout or recreation session.
cards.short_summary: A practical stop for learning where campus recreation happens.
cards.evidence_claim: Roger Williams University’s campus map lists the Campus Recreation Center.
cards.access_notes: Facility access and programming can vary; confirm current requirements on arrival.

cards.title: Use dinner as a meeting point
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · campus dining
cards.notes: Meet a new hallmate at The Commons for a straightforward first meal, and confirm current dining access or payment details before ordering.
cards.short_summary: A named campus dining location for an easy first conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: Roger Williams University’s campus map lists The Commons as a dining area.
cards.access_notes: Dining access, menu, and payment arrangements are subject to current university operations.

cards.title: Mark the arts building on your map
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · academic core
cards.notes: Walk past the Fine Arts Center during an early campus loop and make a note of its location for future exhibitions, classes, or performances.
cards.short_summary: An academic landmark for future arts programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Roger Williams University’s campus map lists the Fine Arts Center.
cards.access_notes: Exterior viewing is appropriate; building access may be limited outside scheduled activity.

cards.title: Choose a future reset spot
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · campus
cards.notes: Visit the University Library to locate entrances and study areas, then check its site before returning for research help, collections, or quiet work.
cards.short_summary: A dependable academic anchor for the first semester.
cards.evidence_claim: Roger Williams University’s campus map lists the University Library.
cards.access_notes: Check the library website for current access conditions and service hours.

cards.title: Check the library’s cultural calendar
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · University Library
cards.notes: Look at the Mary Tefft White Cultural Center’s current listings, then choose a future lecture or exhibit that fits your schedule and interests.
cards.short_summary: A library-based venue for lectures, exhibitions, and discussion.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mary Tefft White Cultural Center at RWU hosts the Talking in the Library lecture series, whose lectures are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Mary Tefft White Cultural Center | Roger Williams University
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current event listing and any attendance instructions before visiting.

cards.title: Continue the campus loop
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · academic core
cards.notes: Pass the Marine and Natural Sciences Building on a daylight walk and use it as another reference point for navigating between campus zones.
cards.short_summary: A named academic building on the campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: Roger Williams University’s campus map lists the Marine and Natural Sciences Building.
cards.access_notes: Exterior viewing is appropriate; building access may be limited outside scheduled activity.

cards.title: Find the performance venue
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · campus
cards.notes: Locate the Performing Arts Center so you can recognize it when campus performance listings appear, and check event details before making plans to attend.
cards.short_summary: A campus venue to keep in mind for future performances.
cards.evidence_claim: Roger Williams University’s campus map lists the Performing Arts Center.
cards.access_notes: Event admission and building access vary; verify details with the presenting program.

cards.title: Take a daylight bay walk
cards.subtitle: Saturday late afternoon · Bristol
cards.notes: Use marked pathways at Colt State Park for a daylight walk with bay views, and check current park notices before you travel from campus.
cards.short_summary: A nearby public park with waterfront paths and open lawns.
cards.evidence_claim: Rhode Island DEM describes Colt State Park as having Narragansett Bay views, hiking trails, paved bikepaths, open fields, and four miles of paved pathways.
cards.source_title: Colt State Park | Rhode Island State Parks
cards.access_notes: Follow current Rhode Island State Parks notices, rules, and any construction guidance.

cards.title: Pick one welcome-week activity
cards.subtitle: Sunday · plan the week ahead
cards.notes: Review RWU’s involvement information and choose one club, organization, or scheduled welcome-week event to try during your first full week.
cards.short_summary: A low-pressure final step toward joining campus life.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU states that students can connect with organizations and clubs through Roger Link and describes involvement opportunities outside the classroom.
cards.access_notes: Review current event details, registration requirements, and accessibility information before attending.
